admission.justification: Joining the worker through cancellation prevents late writes and reads under already-cleared request state.

applicability: The worker tasks entered by the registered native role start and role start set handlers.
conditions: The shielded worker drains through cancellation before the caller leaves its request scope and runs allocator trim.
When held, the enclosing write lock remains owned during the drain.
exclusions: Pre-thread refusals have no worker to drain.
Detached asynchronous quality computations have an independent owner.

evidence: bug-r18-W2-expanded-evidence.md, L18-F02 and both registered cancellation controls.
handoff.path: BUG-L18 W2 affected knowledge and initial history

statement: The tool server drains a registered role-start worker before clearing its request memo and trimming free allocator pages, including when the caller cancels.
